translation: It grows in the fields of Yongzhou. Gather the root in the first month, the leaves in the third month, the stems in the fifth month, the flowers in the ninth month, and the fruits in the eleventh month; all are dried in the shade. (Atractylodes [朮], wolfberry root [枸杞根] and mulberry root white bark [桑根白皮] are its envoys.
